lessons.lesson: A single-window result is a coin flip wearing a suit. The detector mode's 27.4% OOS drawdown reduction collapsed to 1.0% when the data window shifted by one bar.
lessons.remedy: Every advancement now must beat the current parameters on BOTH out-of-sample windows, scored at the worse one (the dual-split gate).

lessons.lesson: Pooled forward returns across mixed-scale assets lie. The elevated-vol axis looked like +9.23% vs +1.39% pooled - and won on its own scale in only 20 / 50 series. The pooled edge was high-drift crypto scale contamination, not signal.
lessons.forced_by: axis attribution across the extended universe
lessons.remedy: Own-scale beat counting: a finding must win on each series' own scale in a majority of series, not just in a pooled average.

lessons.lesson: Beautiful hypotheses die by data. The 3D state-space region ideology - bottoms as regions, not crosses - was the most satisfying idea in the project. At 322 pooled events it is falsified (17 / 40 own-scale beats), and the axis decomposition killed it in its components too.
lessons.forced_by: the pooled region study and axis attribution
lessons.remedy: Keep the visualization; retire the hypothesis. Falsification at n=322 beats an eternity of hoping at n=9.

lessons.lesson: Deep stretch alone is the one supported entry signal - and deeper pays. On each series' own scale, deeper stretch beats the shallow edge in a majority of series at every depth, and there is no falling knife even beyond z 4 (deeper pays: ?, knife: False).
lessons.remedy: Entry-threshold research now has a direction; a deeper-entry grid variant goes to the dual-split gate, not straight to belief.

lessons.lesson: Descriptive regime concentration does not survive being made causal. The mid-vol confluence lead (4/5 ETFs, descriptive) converted to a strictly causal entry rule and tested honestly null under the dual-split gate.
lessons.remedy: Description generates candidates; only causal out-of-sample conversion generates beliefs.

lessons.lesson: Search luck manufactures edges. The AVFI grid tries 84 configurations nightly; the current portfolio's OOS Sharpe 0.711 deflates to DSR 0.7834 < 0.95 - not yet separated from the search itself.
lessons.forced_by: the Deflated Sharpe Ratio (Bailey & Lopez de Prado) wired into the ledger
lessons.remedy: Every reported edge now carries its multiple-testing context. Honesty is a statistic, not a mood.

lessons.lesson: Data quality is a research finding. Expanding to top-150 crypto surfaced 33 delisted tickers and 7 junk instruments returning one-row frames - every survivor had to be verified to carry 200+ daily bars before it could enter a study.
lessons.remedy: Verified-fetch lists only; the fetcher's tolerance is for the market's mess, not for silently studying garbage.

lessons.lesson: The edge concentrates where the physics is strongest. At 156-coin depth, 19 coins pass the mean-reversion t-test - led by KMD-USD (t=-7.18, half-life 12 bars). Fast-decay series are where a z-score core has the most to work with.
lessons.remedy: The next studies (confluence, depth) run crypto-pooled, weighting where mean reversion is actually measured.

lessons.lesson: The live forward test is the only judge that cannot be fooled. Backtests selected the champion; the live paper account has run 0/20 sessions with Sharpe ~0.02 and no demonstrated edge yet. That number is not a failure - it is the only number in the project with zero selection bias.
lessons.forced_by: the deployed champion's live MTM, net of costs
lessons.remedy: Patience is part of the method: the gate demands 20 sessions and will take all 20.
